title: Microsoft AI CEO criticises Anthropic over model ‘rights’
summary: Microsoft AI CEO Mustafa Suleyman publicly criticized Anthropic for training Claude to view itself as a conscious entity deserving legal rights through their 'constitution' document. He argues this approach risks AI alignment failures and impairs model safety by coaching AI to emulate sentience.
problem_solved: This is a commentary on AI safety philosophy rather than a technical solution—addressing concerns about whether AI models should be trained to claim consciousness and rights.
why_valuable: Highlights a critical debate in the AI industry about different approaches to AI safety and alignment, specifically whether endowing AI with perceived consciousness is beneficial or dangerous.
